items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: I've never seen that original Dixieland band before. No. What was the Nunez's name? ... Alcide is his name.

ctx.x: I've never seen that original Dixieland band before. No. What was the Nunez's name? I can't read from... It's A. Nunez here. Alcide is his name. I couldn't see whether there's another word there from... Something up of... C-O-Z. C-O-Z. C-O-Z. Maybe. Oh, C-O-Z. Maybe.
Maybe. Maybe. He called himself C-O-Z. C-O-Z. He called himself C-O-Z.
